name: Enterprise Mesh
tagline: The fleet view. Not the single-agent view.
summary: Everything in OBS-01, OBS-02, OBS-03, and AUD-02. Multi-agent swarm view, Sentry and healthchecks.io integration, dedicated support, SLA. For teams running agent fleets, not single agents.
description: Enterprise Mesh is the fleet contract. One price, the full observability and compliance overlay, a swarm view across agents, and an SLA with a named support path. Sentry and healthchecks.io are first-class, not a webhook afterthought. This is not OBS-01 with a bigger number. It is the SKU you sell when the buyer already thinks in fleets.
buyer: A team running many agents — a swarm, a vertical fleet, or a set of production workers — that needs one picture, one SLA, and one invoice.

features.name: Everything above
features.detail: OBS-01 vitals, OBS-02 signed trail, OBS-03 drift and quality, AUD-02 compliance overlay.

features.name: Multi-agent swarm view
features.detail: Fleet health, spend, drift, and trail across agents — not a tab per agent.

features.name: Sentry integration
features.detail: Agent exceptions and failed runs land next to the rest of the stack.

features.name: healthchecks.io integration
features.detail: External heartbeat as a second opinion on alive/dead.

features.name: Dedicated support
features.detail: Named path. Not a shared inbox.

features.name: SLA
features.detail: Uptime and response commitments written into the contract.

source_components.maps_to: Signed, hash-chained trail at fleet scale.

readiness.blocker: OBS-01 surface inside the mesh still needs the same dashboard polish. Trail, drift, quality, and compliance do not.
readiness.next_action: Sell to fleet buyers. Do not wait on OBS-01 polish to open ENT conversations — lead on trail, drift, SLA.
